amount.description: What the alert says arrived, in its currency.

closed_at.description: When it closed, expired or was dismissed.

closed_line_id.description: A closed signal: the statement line that closed it.

invoice.description: The open invoice it most likely pays: of its amount and currency, its customer named by the payer; absent when there is none, or more than one.

money_account_id.description: The money account the money arrived in.

payer.description: Who the alert says paid, as the bank names them.

status.description: pending while it waits for its statement line; closed by the line reconciled to its invoice; expired after the organisation's bank.signal_expiry_days (7 by default); dismissed by a person.
